# Texas Humane Network

> A statewide animal welfare organization dedicated to humane education, cruelty prevention, and advocacy for animals across Texas.

Texas Humane Network combines educational programs like Critter Camps and humane curriculum with advocacy efforts on animal protection legislation and cruelty prevention. The organization serves schools, communities, and individuals throughout Texas with resources, training, and legal guidance on animal welfare issues.

## Key Topics

- Animal Welfare
- Humane Education
- Animal Cruelty Prevention
- Critter Camps
- Humane Curriculum
- Humane Library Project
- Texas Animal Law
- Community Outreach
- Child Education
- Animal Advocacy
- Reporting Animal Abuse
- Nonprofit Organization
- Texas Schools
- Disaster Preparedness
- Tethering Legislation

## Organization

- [Texas Humane Network](https://texashumanenetwork.org): Homepage for Texas Humane Network's animal welfare and advocacy
- [About](https://texashumanenetwork.org/about): Organization mission, leadership, and board of Texas Humane Network
- [Contact Us](https://texashumanenetwork.org/contact-us): Contact information and animal abuse reporting for Texas Humane Network
- [Join the Team](https://texashumanenetwork.org/careers): Job openings and employment opportunities at Texas Humane Network

## Humane Education Programs

- [Humane Education](https://texashumanenetwork.org/you-can-help/humane-education): Humane education programs including Critter Camps and curriculum resources
- [Critter Camps](https://texashumanenetwork.org/critter-camps): Critter Camps humane education program for children across Texas
- [Humane Curriculum](https://texashumanenetwork.org/you-can-help/humane-curriculum): Third-grade humane curriculum and lesson plans for Texas schools
- [Humane Library Project](https://texashumanenetwork.org/you-can-help/humane-library-project): Humane Library Project providing animal welfare books to school districts
- [Teaching Kids to be Kind to Animals](https://texashumanenetwork.org/teaching-kids-to-be-nice-to-animals): Guide for teaching children kindness and empathy toward animals

## Animal Welfare & Cruelty Prevention

- [Animal Cruelty](https://texashumanenetwork.org/animal-cruelty): Animal cruelty prevention guide and reporting information
- [Animal Topics](https://texashumanenetwork.org/animal-topics): Resources on pet safety, animal cruelty, and disaster preparedness
- [Animal Hoarding](https://texashumanenetwork.org/animal-hoarding): Animal hoarding signs, mental health issues, and rescue resources
- [Animal Fighting](https://texashumanenetwork.org/animal-fighting): Information on dogfighting, cockfighting, and animal welfare
- [Animal Cruelty & Mass Shootings](https://texashumanenetwork.org/animal-cruelty-mass-shootings): Connection between animal cruelty and violence prevention research

## Animal Protection Advocacy

- [Tethering Toolkit](https://texashumanenetwork.org/you-can-help/tethering-toolkit): Advocacy toolkit for dog tethering legislation and community action
- [Breed Bans](https://texashumanenetwork.org/breed-bans): Breed-specific legislation and dog safety policy information
- [Abandoning Animals](https://texashumanenetwork.org/abandoning-animals): Information on Texas animal abandonment laws and legal penalties
